resources.string: Choose a hero you already welcomed and buy that character’s personal fragments with earned runes and crystals. Fragments stay with their exact hero and improve stars or awakening talents. The workshop opens progressively with your village, campaign and completed facilities. It complements recruitment; it never recruits a new hero.

Stock is shared by rarity across all heroes: 6 common, 4 rare, 2 epic and 1 legendary fragment each day. Mythic stock is 1 fragment each week. Spending the common stock on one hero leaves fewer fragments for the others. Daily stock renews at midnight UTC; mythic stock renews on Monday at midnight UTC.

Prices follow campaign progress and remain proportional to adventure loot: roughly two encounters per common fragment, three per rare, four per epic, six per legendary and eight per mythic. Epic and higher fragments also cost crystals. These materials are also used by equipment, so buying fragments is a choice alongside improving your forge.

Common: chapter 2 and an inn. Rare: chapter 3, route 40 and forge rank 1. Epic: chapter 5, route 120 and forge rank 2. Legendary: chapter 8, route 500 and forge rank 3. Mythic: chapter 12, route 2,000, forge rank 3 and academy rank 3. Every tier needs a completed inn.
